Identical structure and dimensions (0.25/0.15/0.15/0.15/0.20=0.90 total) to a sister house's equivalent railing detail on its own ST.3 sheet -- confirms this is shared design-office boilerplate across the house series, not house-specific.

The 'Ø' symbol printed before each steel-bar callout is dimensionally odd for a flat bar (Ø normally denotes a round bar diameter) -- recorded verbatim as printed rather than silently corrected to a flat-bar notation; a sister house's identical detail made the same verbatim choice.
